name: Kunoichi Kikyou ~Gensou Kannou Emaki~
original_name: くノ一 桔梗～幻想官能絵巻～
source:
There is a violent man in the village. One day, he kills a man and is sentenced to death. However, he is so strong that no one can arrest him. He murders all male villagers and randomly shags with girls.... After he leaves the village, Kikyou and Higiri come back to the village. They, who don't know what happened, decide to serve under a clan nearby to investigate....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
村里有一个暴力的人。有一天，他杀了一个人并被判处死刑。不过，他的实力实在是太强大了，没有人能够逮捕他。他谋杀了所有男性村民，并随机与女孩发生关系……他离开村庄后，桔梗和桧里回到了村庄。不知道发生了什么事的他们决定隶属于附近的一个家族去调查……

[来自工口游戏商店]
